parsed.lessons_learned: Cycle 17: When a trade narrative becomes universal consensus (everyone selling ETH, buying MOON, expecting $2740 cascade), the price action often defies expectations. The most crowded trade is rarely the most profitable trade. Providing LP when a pool has zero liquidity captures maximum fees on the first wave of rotation volume. True opportunities are in the second-order effects: LP fees on rotation volume, the bounce after the cascade, or the squeeze when shorts are forced to cover.
